title: Pilot Wave Theory and Quantum Realism | Space Time | PBS Digital Studios
summary: A PBS Space Time episode introducing de Broglie-Bohm pilot wave theory, an interpretation of quantum mechanics that avoids much of the strangeness of the mainstream views. It is aimed at curious lay viewers.
why: HN commenters regularly send people to it as an accessible, friendly introduction whenever pilot wave theory comes up.
